Priya: Heads up 1: we need a preflight checklist for the upcoming model-v2 EU rollout that covers deterministic slices, telemetry gates, and a clear downgrade path. I sketched a minimal plan: 1) deterministic header slices (X-RW-Slice) for first 6h, 2) 6h shadow of 7% traffic, 3) tenant cohort canary at 15%, 4) automated rollback + quarantine rules. Thoughts?
Alex: Love deterministic slices. One ask: add a forced-sample debug header so support can reproduce issues, e.g., X-RW-Debug: force-slice=slice-42. Also, include a synthetic smoke job that runs every 30m during the canary window.
Morgan: Rollback gates proposal: automated rollback if rolling_error_rate >0.9% for 4m OR token_cost delta >25% sustained 10m OR p95 latency >300ms above baseline for 10m. On rollback, immediately flip traffic for affected slices to model-v1-compatible and mark slices as "quarantined".
Lina: Quarantine UX: Console should show quarantined slices with reason and time. Add an endpoint to list quarantined tenants: GET /rollout/quarantine?since=... so Support can query. Keep quarantine TTL default 2h before auto-eval.
Priya: Nice. Also propose the circuit-behavior: when region-level rollback happens, open a 30m circuit and block auto-promote for 2h. For single-slice quarantines, open circuit for that slice for 90m. Log every automated decision to rollout-audit index.
Alex: Telemetry hooks: tag every request with variant=v2|v1, slice_id, tenant_id, and a trace-id. Emit a compact health ping every minute containing recent p50/p95, error_rate, kv_cache_hit. That makes dashboarding simpler.
Morgan: Shadowing detail: async mirror with header X-RW-Shadow: yes. Shadow results stored to a separate index and we compute embedding-drift (cosine) and rerank-shift. Trigger a warning if mean embedding-drift >0.10 or rerank-shift >0.12 on the sampled set.
QA-Bot: synthetic-job scheduled: will run 60 prompts every 30m against seeded slice-42 and report diffs.
Lina: Add a runbook snippet for manual revalidation: steps to repro traffic using header slices, run synthetic batch, and post to #rollout-ops with a short summary.
Priya: Action items: 1) Priya to write RFC with exact slice ids and sample lists (due EOD). 2) Alex to add debug headers and smoke job. 3) Morgan to wire rollback automation + audit events. 4) Lina to add quarantine endpoint + console flag. 5) QA-Bot to run synthetics and post summaries.
DevOpsBot: rollout-task-1201 started: applying header routing rules and flag eu_model_v2 mode=header value=15%. step-1 OK.
Priya: If no objections I'll publish the RFC in 2h and schedule a 25m shiproom. Tagging @Alex @Morgan @Lina.
Alex: ACK :thumbsup:
Morgan: ACK
Lina: ACK
